description: Land Acquisition -Waldeniya, Kegalle D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a land acquisition notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically describes the acquisition of land lots for the development of a water-way and restoration of a bus depot in Kegalle, including detailed descriptions of the properties, claimants, and compensation inquiry procedures. The content is exclusively focused on land and property matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
